findings.summary: Absent-image detection depends on stderr containing 'no such image' with exit code 1; other docker CLI/message variants become IMAGE_PRESENCE_UNKNOWN and skip pre-build.
findings.evidence: Candidate returns False only when exit_code==1 and 'no such image' in stderr.lower(); otherwise None. Lifecycle then runs up without compose build, which can still inline-build and exhaust DOPEMUX_MCP_UP_TIMEOUT_SECS.

findings.summary: Dry-run still executes docker image inspect (read-only side effect) to plan build vs up.
findings.evidence: will_build/present are computed before the dry_run branch; tests assert dry_run runner.calls kinds == {'inspect'}.
